Package neqsim.process.util.scenario

Class CompressorAutomationStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.scenario.CompressorAutomationStudy
public final class CompressorAutomationStudy extends Object
Reusable synthetic compressor automation train with actual equipment, sampled instruments and native trip actions.

The two finite separators own process inventory. The compressor is a quasi-steady synthetic map element. The cooler uses native effectiveness, cooling-utility actuation and thermal lag; that lag is not a separate metal or coolant energy inventory. Valve demands use native choked gas-Cv hydraulics. The explicitly ordered fixed-step runner solves compressor flow against current discharge inventory pressure before either vessel consumes its boundary. It is not a distributed surge, acoustic, rotor-inertia or certified protection model.

Author:
NeqSim

    • performanceMetrics

      private static Map<String,Object> performanceMetrics(List<Map<String,Object>> samples, CompressorAutomationStudy.Train train, CompressorAutomationStudy.CaseDefinition definition)
      Calculates declared control and safeguarding metrics from the actual accepted-step samples.

      The result deliberately distinguishes routed export and recycle mass from relief or disposal load. The synthetic train has no connected PSV, blowdown valve or flare model, so those quantities remain not evaluated rather than being reported as zero.

      Parameters:
      samples - actual accepted-step samples
      train - actual configured train retaining governed policy and native SIF timings
      definition - initiating-event timing
      Returns:
      strict structured metric evidence
